key_catalyst: Nvidia's proposed $250B backstop for an OpenAI data center
reasoning: The reported $250B Nvidia backstop for OpenAI is a novel, high-severity challenge to the credibility of AI demand, while rising hike expectations and megacap earnings scrutiny reinforce the risk. Similar AI-capex concerns drove QQQ lower on July 23 and July 24 and remained unresolved on July 27; today's financing revelations and Chinese lithography breakthrough suggest further escalation.
